articleTitle: Plant disease detection and management using deep learning approach
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Plant diseases impede the average growth of plants and are one of the main reasons behind the decline in production, leading to economic loss. Early detection of the diseases helps provide a cure that can restrict the spread of the diseases within the plant. This review provides a framework for classifying plants as diseased/healthy based on leaf health using various deep learning models such as ResNet50, InceptionV3, ResNet152V2, and AlexNet and implementing those models on two different datasets, namely cotton and plant village datasets, improved respective performance. The experimental results show that the proposed models for plant disease detection and management using ResNet50, InceptionV3, ResNet152V2, and AlexNet perform well to provide a feasible solution for predicting disease among various plant leaves. But with the use of ResNet152V2 as compared to other classifiers, which gives an accuracy of 100% on the cotton dataset and 94.32% with the plant village dataset in search of the healthy or diseased plant additional to that if detected leaves are diseased, the model provides information on each disease and feasible solution. The results demonstrate that the proposed prediction mechanism represents a new effective way to predict diseases with better accuracy. The models were deployed to a web application using a flask to give users a medium to interact and utilize the mechanism.

articleTitle: Children biometric recognition for the betterment of society using deep intelligence
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Missing and abduction of children is a big social issue nowadays. According to the National Crime Records Bureau, India reports more than 100 children go missing every day. Children are in the developing stage till their adulthood. Their biometrics also go through many changes. Therefore, biometric identification system for children is not yet developed. Children's recognition using their biometrics is a challenging task. Many researchers are working on this problem using different biometrics, such as finger, foot, palmprint, face, iris, ear and headprint. However, the issue is not yet resolved satisfactorily. The problem in recognizing children is the small size of biometrics. It is under developing stage, therefore displacement of key features observed, which leads to false acceptance. In this research the footprint biometric is used for identification of children. Most of the work done in literature is in verification mode. In this paper biometric identification is performed which will be helpful in finding the missing children. The database of 50 children's footprint is collected. The age of the children is 1 month to 5 years. Two types of input images are compared to achieve high accuracy. First input images are obtained by pre-processing and Region of Interest (ROI) extraction of the crease pattern from footprint images. Second are obtained by texture-based enhancement of crease pattern's ROI. Both the inputs are compared using state-of-the-art techniques and modern deep learning algorithms. The deep learning algorithm with enhanced crease patterns is giving 100 % accuracy, which is higher than the literature.

articleTitle: An efficient SAR image detection based on deep dense-mobile net method
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Nowadays, many studies are based on the Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) for detecting a ship which is more important for its safety. This method is used to safeguard the ship from lousy weather and reach it on its time. In recent times, the studies are advanced with deep learning for very sensitive calculation with higher accuracy skills; the SAR image is also worked on it. In this brief, the proposed deep learning of hybrid DenseNet and mobile (DMN) is implemented to detect the ship. This technique is based on the convolutional neural network (CNN), a multi-layer classifier. This method combines DenseNet and mobile techniques that are used to classify the missing ship and detect the false alarm with higher precision. The results are simulated and compared with the previous method by validating parameters like precision, recall, and F1 score. The results showed that the proposed DMN is much more effective than the previous deep learning in ship detection.

articleTitle: Optimization of SDRAM memory controller for high-speed operation
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Most conventional processors utilize cache storage with static random access memory. Other technologies have also been used to store caches, such as integrated dynamic-random access memory and Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory (SDRAM). SDRAM has more excellent transmission rates than the asynchronous Random Access Memory (DRAM). To govern the data flow, a memory controller is required. A high-speed storage controller also uses high dynamic power and speed restriction. This requires an optimized memory controller to minimize the memory controller's power consumption. This study suggested lowering the memory controller's dynamic power by minimizing switching operations and increasing the refreshing. This study aims to deploy a controller design using the refresh technique switching power optimization in the Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC). The performance of the Xilinx 14.4 ISE simulator is assessed.

articleTitle: Violence detection for surveillance systems using lightweight CNN models
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Due to significant safety concerns, today, many places are filled with CCTV cameras, but it still uses manual security to overlook these, which leaves much space for human error, be it negligence or a dangerous situation. This may result in many anomalies such as violence, hostage, or fires. To prevent this, an intelligent and automated system has been implemented that tries to overcome this using deep learning techniques. Using Deep Learning models utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), specifically the lightweight models - MobileNetV2 and ResNet50V2 are used to identify threat movements in the given frames over three datasets, namely UCF crime, Real life violence situations, and UBI-fights. The violence in the video is detected using frames, and accuracy is measured. A threat is detected by the system from the video frame, based on which the system for the situation generates an alert. In extreme cases, alerts are sent directly to nearby police stations and emergency services with accurate location information while also indicating the suspicious activities at an instance of time.

articleTitle: Prediction of EV battery SOC using a charging and discharging model
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Li-ion battery packs, which are increasingly being utilized in Electric Vehicles (EV), Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEV), Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), and smart grid systems, require accurate estimation of State of Charge (SOC). The SOC, often known as the actual quantity of battery energy remaining, is a critical factor in guaranteeing the performance and consistency of lithium-ion batteries. Modern lithium-based batteries can be safeguarded against damage and mishaps by a Battery Management System. A lithium battery management system can ensure that the battery operates in a reliable and secure environment, hence increasing the battery's lifespan. A battery management system for Lithium-ion batteries is presented in this research. Presenting a charging and discharging model. The proposed system is simulated using MATLAB/Simulink, and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Explainable AI-based early detection of diabetes for smart healthcare
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Diabetes has become a worldwide epidemic as a chronic disease. Early detection of diabetes without specialized medical instruments may positively impact people's lives. This research aims to construct an intelligent system that uses a machine learning approach to classify diabetic illness. ALTHOUGH, most AI methods are based on mathematical modelling, which is difficult for the common person to comprehend. This research proposes a novel approach within the Explainable AI to explain the knowledge learned by the Machine learning model from Smart Healthcare. Innovative healthcare uses the current generation of digital technologies such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing to completely revolutionize the medical system, making it more efficient and personalized. This work proposes three techniques based on the analysis weights of artificial neurons or nearest neighbors and explaining estimation based on the analysis of training cases. Here, a model is developed with three classifiers to detect diabetes early and explain the most significant input and combination of inputs. The results show remarkable accuracy compared to previous methods, and the explanation makes sense. The hybrid intelligent system can assist medical practitioners in healthcare as a decision support system.

articleTitle: Development of AMBA ACE protocol
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: As advancements in the semiconductor industry are on a rapid scale, certain product-based, as well as EDA tool vendors, focus on better scaling, reusability, and low power consumption in different peripherals and interfaces. So, there is a need for a proper channel between these peripheral components such that transactions and data transfer take place vigorously. To cope up with these, different communications protocols have been developed from time to time. AMBA (ARM) has developed a series of a wide range of on-chip interconnects for managing functional blocks on SoC (System on Chip). ACE an advanced version of AXI is a snooping-based communication protocol used for connecting peripherals interface and observe the behavior of transactions. The channels present in this are pipelined and operate simultaneously. Every design needs to be verified to implement all the features and specifications without any lapse. So, a verification environment is very much necessary to execute and verify the simulations. Hence, this paper deals with the development of a verification component that can generate and simulate all signals of the ACE Protocol. The project implements different transactions in form of data and addresses and carries out multiple test scenarios to meet the desired results.

articleTitle: EEG based motor imagery classification using CNN
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Brain-computer interfacing with non-invasive devices is a feasible solution by which severe quadriplegic patients can find an alternative neural path for expressing their actions. We have proposed a deep framework for the four-class classification of motor imagery (MI) tasks (left hand, right hand, both feet, tongue) from an available dataset of BCI competition IV-2a. We converted the electroencephalogram signals of the MI tasks from the motor-cortex area of the brain to scalograms by using the Morse wavelet. A novel deep architecture of a convolutional neural network is presented in this paper to classify these scalogram images. This analysis is carried out in the 8-30 Hz frequency band. The maximum classification accuracy reached up to 73.28%. Parameter tuning of the proposed framework is done by varying the batch size and number of epochs until an optimum value is reached. Our results show the possibility of the use of non-invasive MI to extend in medical and non-medical applications also.

articleTitle: Clustering solutions and analysis for cognitive radio Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Cognitive radio Wireless Sensor Network is one of the emerging technologies to address the challenges of conventional wireless networks. The core functionality of any network like Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET), Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), etc., is based on the routing mechanism. For CR-WSNs, three types of routing schemes are used such as multihop routing, one-hop routing, and cluster-based routing. Because of the potential for impractical methods with the one-hop routing and the latency correlated with the multihop routing, the cluster-based routing is considered encouraging. Thus clusteringbased solutions received more attention for WSNs and CR-WSNs than other routing strategies. While working with CR-WSNs, the primary constraints are limited processing power and sensor nodes, and hence it is necessary to consider energy-efficient clustering design to enhance the network lifetime. Several clustering solutions are proposed for WSNs. However, it is noticed that clustering methods of WSNs cannot directly be applied to CR-WSNs due to topology variations. Designing the clustering protocol for CR-WSNs is a challenging problem compared to WSN. This article briefly reviews the current clustering protocols in CRSN and performs a comparative performance analysis on some of these protocols. The experimental results are derived through simulation, and the results are plotted for performance parameters such as throughput, packet delivery rate (PDR), overhead, energy consumption, and delay. The paper concludes by focusing on the standard protocols' performance variations.

articleTitle: The state of the art design methodology of sierpinski carpet fractal structures in microstrip patch antenna
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Demand in wireless applications is due to low cost, low weight, compact size, single-band, and multiband frequency characteristics. Researchers anticipate numerous approaches to reach their goal. The patch antenna comprises 3 layers. Patch shapes are in the form of rectangle, triangle, circle, square, etc. Different types of substrates like Rogers, FR-4, RT Duroid, Foam, etc., are used in fractal antenna depending upon the demand of applications. Feeding techniques like coaxial feed, microstrip line feed, proximity feed, aperture feed, etc., can be used based on the requirement of antenna design. As a result, the current distribution of the antenna becomes better in carpet fractal antenna. Patch antennas are operated in GHz and THz frequencies. This paper presents a comprehensive survey on Sierpinski carpet fractal structures, including design expressions and applications.

articleTitle: Heart disease prediction using machine learning and data analytics approach
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In recent times, Machine Learning has played a significant role in the healthcare industry and amongst all of the major diseases, heart disease is one of the significant and most critical diseases to predict. There is a rapid increase in the number of cases each day. It has been observed that in every minute, 4 people between the age group of 30-50 get a stroke, so we are using machine learning algorithms to mitigate this problem. Kaggle used the heart disease dataset used for this project. This paper demonstrates the prediction of heart disease using multiple machine learning classification algorithms such as Naive Bayes, Random Forest, SVM etc., and compares their accuracy scores. Later on, Stacking Ensemble Learning Technique is used to boost our classification models' performance.

articleTitle: An effective method for charging electric vehicles through wireless power transfer system
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) systems transfer electricity without a wired connection from a source to a charge. The advantages of wired compared with cable systems such as no exposed wires, ease of loading, and fearless power transmission into adverse environmental conditions make the WPTs appeal to many industrial applications. Some companies have paid attention to the adoption of WPTs for charging the onboard batteries of electrical vehicles (EV), and efforts are made to develop and improve the various topologies associated with these systems. WPT is obtained by the cost-effective induction of two spins known as the transmitter and the receiver. The transmitter bobbins are entered into the road in EV charging applications, and receiver bumps are placed in the vehicle. Resonant type inductive WPT is common for medium-high power transmission applications such as EV charging because its effectiveness is increased. The Wireless Power Transfer emerged as the fastest-growing technology for power transmission without cables. This field is getting new proposals and advancements in technology, making this more reliable and efficient. Hence, this becomes a field for the newly manufactured electric vehicles that rely only on wireless charging. Here, the wireless power transfer takes place with the help of ‘Inductive & Magnetic Coupling.’

articleTitle: Multiclass classification for DDoS attacks using LSTM time-series model
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: As the penetration of the Internet into the interior of the third world keeps on increasing, more people come onto the Internet to communicate and globalize this behemoth. Thus, generating and consuming large amounts of data. To service the increasing number of customers and their data needs, we need to set up new servers increasingly. Having many people using the Internet can also be a problem as they might be a part of a DDoS attack unknowingly. In Botnet, a Bot-Herder infects many computers with Botnet malware, remotely controlling multiple devices, and makes them accomplices in DDoS attacks. People are getting included in a botnet sphere unknowingly. The traditional cyber security paradigm has become obsolete because of the conventional approaches. Thus, machine learning has become a necessity in DDoS intrusion detection. In DDoS attacks, multiple malicious packets are sent to the server to stagger its bandwidth, buffer, and CPU power. This paper proposes a Time-Series-based Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model using the LSTM network employed on the CICDDoS2019 dataset. The model outperforms the previous benchmarked models as it achieves maximum value with a 1-layer LSTM model in multiclass grouped classification. The 1- layer LSTM values have F1-Score, Recall, and Precision are 0.980, 0.975, and 0.988, respectively.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of error detection and correction system for semiconductor memory applications
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: VLSI RAM chips build memories in all modern computers. Hence, these devices are highly reliable and can last for decades before a single chip fails. While combining many chips in a single memory, more time is taken to operate. When binary data is written into the memory, the presence of defective chips causes errors. This paper implements the error correction and detection system design for semiconductor memory applications. The primary intent of this paper is to detect and correct errors in an effective way. As a result, the reliability and speed of operation will be increased efficiently.

articleTitle: Design optimization in patch feed line of a circular patch antenna array
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Circular microstrip patch antennas with discontinuities in their feed line is presented in this paper. The antennas are composed of a radiating patch, and step discontinuities are given in its feed lines to improve the performance. The three circular microstrip planar array antennas through various signal excitation lines are computationally designed, and PCB etched, and their performance is analyzed based on various feed lines. The proposed array antenna operates in the ISM band at 2.45 GHz. The HFSS is used to design and perform the simulations. A prototype of an antenna effective at 2.45 GHz has been PCB etched and verified for concept demonstration. S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> [dB] at 2.45 GHz is −21.143 dB for straight feed line, −22.0 dB for one step feed line, and −24.72 dB for two-step feed line. The computational and practical outcomes illustrate that the S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> [dB] is enhanced for circular microstrip patch array antennas with two-step feed lines. The simulated and measured scattering parameters and radiation patterns show that they are in good agreement.

articleTitle: An improved DFT spread with genetic algorithm in layered PTS for reduced PAPR in FBMC OQAM systems
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The Partial Transmit Sequence (PTS) is the innovative method for low Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) in multicarrier modulations (MCM). The Filter Bank Multi-carrier (FBMC) method proves a promising technique in advanced wireless communication. The addition of the cyclic prefix reduces the interferences that cause spectral efficiency degradation. Also, computational complexity is the major problem in MCM. It is anticipated to use a Genetic Algorithm (GA) and improve DFT spread in a layered partial transmit sequence (GA-LPTS). The projected system endures splitting each subblock, renovating the conventional PTS's one-layer structure into a dual-layer phase rotation factors search arrangement, and introducing a consequence-related threshold point. The GA then obtains the suboptimal phase factor vectors before PAPR reduction processing. The DFT spread IGA-LPTS scheme successfully condenses the FBMC/OQAM signal's PAPR. The anticipated results are compared to those obtained using the penalty concave-convex procedure (penalty-CCCP) and the carrier frequency offset (CFO) algorithm.

articleTitle: Conquering the COVID-19 pandemic: a deep learning based approach
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: As the world continues to grapple with COVID-19, public places are opening gradually. However, it is necessary to adhere to the guidelines released by governments across the world to prevent an increase in the number of cases. The major guidelines which have proven to be quite effective include covering one's face and nose and maintaining distance from others. To enforce these guidelines, this work proposes a model to detect and classify people into three classes; wearing mask, no mask, and incorrectly worn mask using the YOLOv5 algorithm for object detection. A novel mathematical formula for distance estimation labels people as safe or unsafe based on the distance maintained from others. This model is trained specifically for helping in the enforcement of the guidelines in the context of reopening of indoor establishments like malls, theatres, and restaurants in India, where the general population makes use of various types of face coverings like handkerchiefs, scarves, face shields in addition to surgical and handmade masks. This work also provides a comparison between Scaled-YOLOv4 and YOLOv5 in terms of their accuracy with a custom dataset. The proposed model achieved a peak accuracy of 94.67% using the YOLOv5 algorithm and an accuracy of 92% for social distance estimation. The model trained using the Scaled-YOLOv4 algorithm achieved a much lower peak accuracy of 74.51%.

articleTitle: Fatigue analysis case study of welded profiles for automotive utilization
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The study of fatigue failure of welded design is recently more complicated in the industries, in the particular automotive domain. Indeed, numerous parameters can influence this phenomenon, such as the material type, the geometry dimensions, the quality of the welding used, and the environmental conditions. In this present work, we created a 3-dimensional finite element simulation to predict the durability of a design based on welded profiles for transportation utilization. The results showed the existence of the critical areas at the vicinity of the welded joint and the comparison of the lifetime results of our structure of two methods in the fatigue analysis known as the stress-life and the strain-life methods. Besides, the fatigue sensitivity curve is discussed to represent the reduction of the loading variations with augmentation of durability, and the hysteresis curve (Stress Vs. Strain) is given only in the case of the strain-life method.

articleTitle: An overview on energy-efficient power allocation approach in MIMO-NOMA
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: MIMO technology can enhance the overall performance of current systems without wasting a lot of energy or network bandwidth. NOMA is a good alternative for MIMO frameworks that boost user transmission rates and improve spectral efficiency. Following a brief introduction of relevant work & look at particular prior work on MIMO and offer an overview of previous research. Each method was briefly examined and compared to show its unique features, benefits, and limitations. The concept of an energy-efficient power allocation technique has risen in popularity as a critical feature of 5G communication. Energy efficiency will be one of the essential characteristics of any new technology in the approaching era of communication. As a result, an attempt was made by us to give concepts, designs, and outcomes of several approaches in this work. This proposed system achieves better values for energy efficiency & the number of users admitted.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid technique with optimization for enabling Qos for network controlled vertical handoff mechanism in heterogonous network
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, vertical handoff mechanisms are becoming an attractive topic that focuses on improving mobility models in this model. Seamless mobility management offers existing Node's location point to another network in a significant way with failure in communication process on different heterogeneous wireless networks provide better service. Handover is also called Handoff, exchanging payload between two different nodes. The handover can be categorized as horizontal and vertical handover. Here, the vertical Handoff is considered where WLAN takes the service (payload) to a cellular network and vice versa. In this work, the proposed technique provides effective handover processing in the wireless sensor network area. Therefore, the proposed technique utilizes a hybrid grey wolf optimization technique (HGWO). The implementation is done on the NS2 platform that helps to prove the proposed technique is better than existing in terms of performance analysis metrics such as Delay, load balancing, throughput, energy, and call drop.

articleTitle: A deep learning based approach for mask detection
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Across the globe, the effects of the Corona Virus is significant, a prevailing system of rules has to be established for the betterment of sustainability of life. Government across several countries are issuing guidelines so that spread of COVID-19 can be curbed. Vaccination is closely associated with immunization as a strong prevention measure, many countries have developed it and required mandatory by every citizen. But unfortunately, it has been observed that a majority of the population is not following basic safety assurance protocols like wearing the mask in public maintaining minimum social distance during the execution of work. This situation is raising a big threat of the spread of the virus in society and life endangerment as well. Countries with a high density of population like India are majorly suffering from these issues. In these countries majority of the population travels through public transport most government offices, as well as educational bodies, are over-crowded. There is an urgent requirement for a proper monitoring system to inspect the compliance of basic rules for safety. Defaulters must be detected, and reminders must be given, followed by punishment. We have developed a solution that can identify people with and without masks and take suitable action accordingly. The deep learning approach to detect the mask is showing up accuracy to a reasonable level. We have used publicly available data sets and random images available on the Internet to test our system.

articleTitle: Catch me if you can: achieving complete internet anonymity using open source technologies
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Search engines aggressively capture user data for targeted advertisements at the cost of user privacy. We present a framework for complete internet anonymity that blocks search engines from tracking user data based on cookies, IP address and search queries . The framework consists of a browser plugin to enable anonymous search by masking browser cookies, a VPN service to enable masking IP address and finally Natural Language Processing models for creating multiple queries to mask user data. Based completely on open source technologies, the framework serves as the first of its kind open source internet anonymity tool.

articleTitle: Energy management using Atmega2560 MCU for residential infrastructure
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Electricity demand has increased dramatically over the last decade, causing many energy management problems. Using a microcontroller to lower the energy consumption of your household infrastructure is one of the numerous strategies to deal with energy management difficulties. It implements a compact design prototype to deliver a comprehensive solution that uses an electronic microcontroller to measure, monitor, and manage energy consumption in a home. The primary purpose of Intelligent Residence is to ensure economic and optimized use of electricity. This article explained the planning, implementation, and application of an automated single-phase energy control action for residential power management. The following post describes measuring power and energy with an Arduino. Proper use of this system in residential infrastructure can significantly reduce overall energy consumption and electricity costs.

articleTitle: Efficient ADD/SHIFT architecture for transposed structure of FIR filter using verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: A low-power VLSI system is used to construct the novel filter design that uses the shift and adds a multiplier. The new FIR is similar indirect and translated to the previous FIR models, such as the direct form and earlier shift structure. The implementation is done on the Transposed structural characteristic of FIR since it is beneficial in low power applications. The Smartphone's residual power was determined to be higher at high frequencies. Though its filters are designed to be as power-efficient as possible, different trade-offs are conceivable. The design was superior in terms of reduced power/area. The novel FIR filter is based on the FPGA device and specified using the Xilinx ise/Vivado Design Suite's in-built multiplies and complete adder.

articleTitle: Smart tour advisor using machine learning and natural language processing
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In the context of recommendation systems, deciding whether to prioritize accuracy above computing time or vice versa is difficult, which is why many researchers prefer hybrid recommendation systems. Researchers are currently working to generate appropriate and correct suggestions to support the use of the ontology but cannot fully use it due to a lack of methodologies. The pure problem of new user cold start, which arises when the system lacks information about the new user, is one of the main challenges of recommender systems that many academics are concerned about [2]. It is advocated in this paper to develop a smart tour advisor by using content-based filtering and item-based collaborative filtering for recommending Hotels, Restaurants, and Tourist Attractions to tourists. It focuses on solving the cold start problem by asking a few questions and analyzing user preferences [3,5,7], eventually making personalized recommendations. Before visiting any destination, any tourist must go through many complex parameters like booking a hotel, looking for the best tourist attractions, and selecting restaurants by seeing their ratings, reviews, and attributes, which is very tedious work. So, it is an end-to-end travel planner web application that will help to make better decisions for your travel routine for any destination.

articleTitle: Home health monitoring for orthopaedic rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The monitoring system has been developed for serious cases of orthopaedic injury and for the health of older people's lifestyles. It has been built for testing and discussion, and the functionality was the most important in contrast to the form aspect. Other issues, such as defence, maintenance and economies of scale, were significant but outside of our control. This is important if the device is utilised but not sufficient for our tests. Home orthopaedic rehabilitation health monitoring Connecting products and installations that eliminate human involvement to live a better existence. Acceleration data are supplied by employing accelerometers for different axis x, y, z in this project. The measuring signals in the motion of the two accelerometers were mounted one on the upper knee and the other on the bottom of the knee, from either side to the knee. Any motions in the joints modify the accelerometers which cause the accelerometer generate the output voltage in relation to gravity variations. Moreover, in combination with heartbeat, the temperature is generated by the output of the alcohol concentration sensor which is sent into the microcontroller. In addition, the microcontroller processes this information to deliver the output transmitted over Bluetooth on the Android mobile device. The android app translates incoming messages to give physician and caregiver detailed information and warning.

articleTitle: Increased throughput and power efficient multi-path 1024-point radix-22 FFT processor for signal processing applications
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: FFT processor used for high-speed signal processing applications, such that to meet the required high-speed applications, FFT processor uses pipeline and parallel processing algorithms to provide such high-speed applications, pipelining techniques such as delay feedback and delay commutation technique are used, for this radix -2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup> algorithm based FFT processor to provide parallel path signal processing implemented pipeline architectures are used. For high throughput radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> algorithms are used. They reduce both the number of adders and the number of rotators. FFT processor occupies an area of 3.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and operating supply voltage of 0.4V-1V, and at a frequency of 600MHz. By taking advantage of Radix-4 algorithm techniques, the processor is implemented with four parallel path signal processing without overhead of hardware compared to the two-path processor. The implemented processor takes less power, approximately 14%, compared to the two-path FFT processor, and the area reduces by 20% using Radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> algorithm techniques. Simulation results are observed using Xilinx ISE 14.7 Design Suite using Verilog-HDL coding.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of broadband WDM system for 5G and beyond
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Demand for large bandwidth is increasing day by day due to the extensive usage of the internet, various gaming applications, and mobile communication. Optical fibers fulfill this requirement because it has enormous bandwidth. In the present article, we have designed a wideband WDM system, which operates in E, S, C, and L bands, over a bandwidth of 29.509 THz (or 273 nm). In the proposed wideband WDM system, the four channels operated at 1427 nm (E band), 1520 nm (S-band), 1550 nm(C band), and 1600 nm (L band). The data rate used was 40 Gbps. The system is analyzed by varying the fiber length from 25 km to 125 km and laser power from −5 dBm to 10 dBm. The system's performance is evaluated by BER, quality factor, output optical power, and eye diagram. We successfully demonstrated that at −5 dBm/100km, the quality factor and BER as 9.39, 9.16, 10.20, 6.76 and 2.80 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−21</sup>, 2.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−20</sup>, 9.45×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−25</sup>, 6.55×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>. Similarly, at 10 dBm/125km the Q factor and bit error rate was 5.13, 24.32, 16.18, 7.64 and 1.36×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−07</sup>, 5.39×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−131</sup>, 2.99×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−59</sup>, 1.05×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> for 10 dBm for the four channels respectively. The proposed wideband WDM system was designed and simulated using optisystem 13.

articleTitle: Modeling and design of single-phase PV inverter with MPPT algorithm applied to standalone PV system
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: This paper modulates a high-performance standalone single-phase PV inverter with MPPT strategy. This proposed system consists of Photovoltaic Array, MPPT Controller, Buck Converters and inverter. Firstly, the Buck converter is modeled and designed for further analysis in this paper. The input to the Converter is fed from MPPT controller. The task of the MPPT controller is to ensure the flow of optimum power from the PV system under variable environmental conditions which provides the reference voltage to the proposed Converter.Secondly a single-phase H-bridge inverter circuit using IGBT is modeled. The duty cycle of the PWM signal varies in such a way that it provides a voltage in a specific pattern across the load will appear to the load as AC signal. After passing the signal through a low pass filter, a pure sin wave is generated. The FFT analysis of the inverter has been bone and the total harmonic distortion of the output voltage was found to be less than 1%. Finally, the dynamic behaviours of the system are investigated in MATLAB/SIMULINK platform.

articleTitle: Water body area identification and classification using hyperspectral images
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The water resource monitoring system based on satellite images has a significant drawback, that it does not deliver reliable data. Main drawbacks in the existing methodologies are, the water resources and their existence could not be correctly recovered, and the results obtained were not conspicuous. The proposed system properly retrieves the existence of water resources and allows monitoring using satellite images. In the proposed system, deep learning based segmentation and SVM classifier have been adopted, which properly retrieves the existence of water resources. The proposed method has been applied on the pond in Karur district and has been found that, 8% of water resource has been reduced during 2019-2020. The proposed method produces the outcomes with the Accuracy of 98% when compared with other existing methods. This method may be used to track water resources with ranges in the future, as well as monitor occupied spots in water resources throughout all districts.

articleTitle: Distributed immutable ledger to maintain integrity and anonymity in health insurance – a blockchain approach
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Health Insurance application and claim process involve doctors, hospitals, lab professionals and policy holders for approvals, making it slow and increasing the chances of anomalies. Previous research has made it possible to store medical reports on decentralised blockchain networks primarily by using private blockchain networks like Hyperledger fabric which doesn't assure no data leakage. Our blockchain's proposed solution will help in easing out the whole process and helping in maintaining integrity and establishing anonymity. We designed data structures for storing insurance payments and agreements, medical service records, and patient records within the ledger. We use smart contracts to automate the insurance claim process and to ensure privacy. This compliance system for the health insurance claim process will increase the privacy of patients' records along with maintaining integrity and anonymity.

articleTitle: Encoding scheme for power reduction in network on chip links
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: As the range of cores at the chip increases, the position of the conversation machine turns into increasingly important. It is observed while calculating ratio between NoClinks and routers, power increases, which results in increasing links which consume more power In a design containing a massive variety of processing cores, the NoC structure can appropriately replace the system-on-chip design. In the NoC, the primary supply of power consumption is the NoC. If you compare the ratio between the chip link and the network on the router link with respect to power, they eat more energy when compared with router. The dynamic energy intake within side the hyperlink is the primary element within side the energy intake of the NoC structure. This is due to own changing, and the other fact is the capacitance due to cross- coupling. In the proposed methology, first, auto-switching is reduced by examining the handover transition, followed by an examination of the coupling between the links and a reduction in power consumption.

articleTitle: Detection of mental disorder on social platform
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Mental Disorders have expanded essentially since the world hit the pandemic. As the world is engaging with COVID-19, people likewise need to manage the increment in psychological wellness issues like depression, anxiety, and suicidal tendencies. While people have been working resolutely to keep their appearances covered, wash hands, and stay 6 feet away from everybody, including friends and family, people might not have acknowledged how the pandemic and isolation have worked on their emotional well-being. This exploration targets assembling a system that distinguishes any mental disorder. The detection will be completed by utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques. Depression is seen as the biggest supporter of worldwide incapacity and significant justification for suicide. The target diminishing the number of suicides occurring, henceforth encouraging people to take the online test which would comprise of a review, and perceive their debilitate/lively state. Early detection makes way for future consideration and treatment. The aim is to build a model which connects the users to counseling services which will help clients to generate solutions to their problems and connect them to respective counselors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of machine learning models for predicting exports of India
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Analysing economic trends and predicting future value of economic variables are key factors for assessing a country's economic outlook. This study pursues a machine learning approach to predict country's exports using other macroeconomic variables, namely, country's GDP, world's exports and real effective exchange rate (REER) by deploying various machine learning algorithms. In this study, Linear Regression, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree and Random Forest machine learning models are applied on India's trade data for the period 1970–2019. By comparing the prediction accuracy, it is found that decision tree regression outperformed the other three algorithms and produced better results for predicting India's exports.

articleTitle: The state of the art on ASR systems and feature extraction technique
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The foremost purpose of a speech enhancement system is to bring out intelligent speech among the mixture of noise, background audio, and the speaker. This can be utilized in intelligent speech transmission, hearing aids, speaker identification, video conferencing, etc. Over the years, many speech enhancement methods have been implemented to process the noisy background and enhance the quality of the speech signal. With the introduction of machine learning, deep learning, and neural networks, this enhancement of speech has become more fruitful. However, the traditional methods like spectral subtraction, wiener filtering, etc., faced the musical noise issue, especially while working on a low SNR signal. While many DNN-based methods are being introduced, denoising and dereverberation are not collectively considered that often. This article provides an overview of the research on speech enhancement techniques in the last several years. The various challenges and future research ideas are also covered, considering the present methods of speech enhancement.

articleTitle: A scalable home automation IoT ecosystem using open source technologies
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Home Automation provides remote access to appliances and devices in a home via the internet. While this is easily achievable on a small scale, the challenge is making the system deployable in a manner that is scalable across a whole city in a developing nation. This paper proposes an end-to-end home automation suite with modular open source components. Our backend supports multiple IoT protocols and is horizontally scalable. We implement a ‘Rules engine’ that analyzes real-time data and triggers various actions pre-determined by users. We also implement energy monitoring for judicial energy consumption in a home. Our system, when deployed, can handle data coming from homes for an entire city. Each user will have remote control of devices in his home through an android application. The user will also be able to define rules to trigger actions in his home via a web dashboard. The architecture used ensures that the system scales as the data traffic increases. Our experiments on the prototype system show low latency for real time analytics even when there are large simultaneous data streams. Our main feature contributions are the modular and dynamic nature of our system, scalability, and real time analytics for quick decision making.

articleTitle: A novel security enhancement mechanism in wireless body area networks using quantum cryptography
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The rapid advancements in miniature electronics, wireless networks, and sensor networks, and embedded computing have revolutionized all real-time application scenarios. One such most obligatory application at present is remote health care. This is made possible via Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs), hopeful in remote health care and assistance. These networks carry personal as well as life-critical information of the users. Hence stringent security mechanisms are required to safeguard these data from intruders. This paper presents a high-level security mechanism based on quantum cryptography for WBANs. A brief comparison of its performance with the enhanced BB84 QKD protocol in terms of efficiency and time complexity analysis. The efficiency and complexity order of the proposed EB92 protocol turned out to be 29% and 2, respectively in contrast to the existing EBB84 which resulted in 42% and 2.86 of the same. Furthermore, the security analysis is done concerning the Time-shift quantum attack.

articleTitle: Blockchain technology: a special survey for new era
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: People have been experiencing their dependency on the centralized agencies. However, there are still many transforms that need to be witnessed. The objective of this paper is focused upon creating awareness about the technology among the people on which people can have faith and trust. Provided an overview of the technology and its existing architecture and futuristic integrations of blockchain technology. A special case of India has been taken by researcher to pointing out the application of blockchain in a country. The technology has specific solutions for different sectors as it has been discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Secure image watermarking using MLDWT and SVD for secure medical data transmission model in healthcare systems
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In this paper, primarily a novel medical image water marking's obsolete to embed a watermark picture, a new watermarking approach because of Multilevel discrete wavelet transform (MLDWT) and singular value decomposition (SVD) is implemented, in which changing most incredible upsides of the cover image in the MLDWT province offers remarkable resilience against typical attacks. As a result of the MLDWT implementation, the algorithm has a high PSNR and correlation coefficient of the watermarked image. The outcomes demonstrated that the MLDWT-SVD perspective is more effective than the existing spatial domain, and DWT drew on methods.

articleTitle: Optimized and adaptive dynamic load balancing in distributed database server
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Modern large-scale and small-scale data applications and processing solutions depend primarily on the distributed database system. Distributed database servers are the most commonly used structures that give data availability, reliability, replication, and processing for both homogeneous and heterogeneous software and hardware systems. One of the significant challenges that will address by distributed file system is a parallel but not intersecting in the data load, which seems to be in the distribution of data items or data access from the nodes in the system. A distributed database system with high availability and scalability gives record offerings in terms of tolerance, availability, and reaction speed. Adaptive load balancing outperforms centralized and distributed load balancing. The technique considers restrictions such as network load, Input and output load, capacity and load, which were not taken into account in the previous method. The restriction satisfying hypothesis, which determines the best level for enhanced system productivity and response time, addresses the load balancing issue. According to experimental results, overall performance assessments in reading and writing operations are enhanced in response time.

articleTitle: Benefits and barriers of cloud computing in online learning
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Online learning is the new way of education. It is flexible, affordable, comfortable, and even self-paced. The hybrid model of learning will persist for a long time. Thus, much research is being undertaken to make the process smooth. Cloud computing- the new IT paradigm possesses the power to change the way of resource consumption in learning today. It is expected to impact the nature of education in a few years. However, cloud computing has not been universally adopted for online learning due to its challenges despite its benefits. This study aims at reporting these challenges and ranking them based on their impact using TISM (Total Interpretive Structural Modelling). MICMAC analysis categorizes these challenges as per their driving power and dependence power. The outcomes of the study brief about these challenges and can help guide future research in this area.

articleTitle: Study of temperature and power consumption in embedded processors
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The demand for increased functionality, enhanced computing power with fewer chips, the number of cores are increasing in the Embedded Processors. The fast pace of progress in technological trends has a significant impact on the temperature and power consumption of Embedded multicore processors, which may further affect the system's performance. In this paper, we present the methods to capture the processor temperature along with other attributes. The power consumption model in a multicore processor is also presented. The various thermal issues in multicore processors different techniques to manage power consumption and temperature in Embedded processors are discussed in the paper. Some platforms available for single-core and multicore processors to study temperature and power consumption are also mentioned. For the processor not having the dynamic range of current and the static operating voltage, designing a task scheduler combined with DVFS and/or DPM is impossible.

articleTitle: User-centric pollution alert system
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In the last few decades, many urban areas in India have suffered from acute air pollution, making air quality an important area of research. Currently, air pollution is increasing daily at an alarming rate due to various reasons, including industrial growth and automobile and chemical industries. This work aims to monitor air pollution and guide users through routes based on the pollution density of the area, along with providing alerts about highly polluted areas. The same has been done by setting up a server and creating a mobile application. The monitoring device collects the pollution levels and stores them in the server along with the timestamp and location details. The mobile application uses the data from the server to send notifications and alerts to the user about high pollution levels. Additionally, the application has been integrated with an algorithm to calculate the least polluted route from the source to the destination as per the user's choice. The application also monitors the user's transits and generates daily, monthly and yearly graphs of the pollution intake. The pollution data consists of concentrations of various air pollutants hourly. Thus, with these features, any person can keep track of their pollution intake and make optimal decisions to reduce the same.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of UWB antenna with multiple notched bands on the feed line
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Transforming present global telecommunications networks into an integrated system capable of offering clients a diverse variety of ubiquitous communications services regardless of location, time of day, or mode of transportation, some devices are crucial because they have a direct impact on the performance of wireless communication. As wireless communication technology advances, smaller antennas are in demand. They often produce a single resonance frequency due to their small bandwidth. These antennas can produce resonances in multiple bands or with a wide bandwidth. This paper is divided into two segments, each focusing on a distinct area of communication technology. The first is investigating and designing novel ultra-wideband (UWB) high-appreciative DRA antennas. The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of patch length, patch width, microstrip line length and breadth, substrate height, and dielectric constant on suggested wireless antenna arrays. The proposed antenna is created and simulated with the High-Frequency Simulator Structure (HFSS) program and then fabricated via photolithography etching. These parameters were simulated and confirmed using the indicated system's return loss and radiation pattern. The proposed antenna can be used for wireless communication applications in the C-band, X-band, and Ku-band bands. The suggested antenna's numerical design and implementation are illustrated (manufacturing and testing).

articleTitle: Conformal CP antenna for sub-6GHz band V2X applications
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: This paper presents a conformal CPW-fed circularly polarized antenna for Sub-6GHz wireless and road safety applications. A coplanar waveguide fed square slot antenna is considered to obtain the broad impedance bandwidth. An Lshaped feeding structure with four stub lines is incorporated to generate orthogonal transverse electric field modes. Three L-shaped strip lines are connected to the ground to enhance the circular polarization (CP) characteristics. Further enhancement of CP bandwidth is obtained by modifying the ground plane. The antenna is fabricated on a flexible polyimide substrate having the dielectric constant εr = 3.5 and height h = 0.1mm. The antenna operates in the range of frequencies 3.23 – 6.26 GHz and exhibits CP bandwidth from 3.02 – 4.25 GHz & 5.30 – 6.07 GHz. A conformal antenna with a cylindrical radius R = 45 mm is analyzed. The antenna operating bandwidth is measured by placing the antenna on a practical car wing mirror. The far-field antenna characteristics are analyzed by locating it on Car roof-top and side-view mirror locations with the help of the Ansys savant tool. The designed radiator is a good candidate for wireless and vehicular safety applications in the multipath urban environment.

articleTitle: Malware analysis in mobile devices
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Mobile Devices are used worldwide nowadays and are being used for most of the tasks we do in our everyday lives. This becomes a good reason for bad people to exploit you somehow. One of the ways is through malware attacks. It can harm us by exploiting our privacy, showing advertisements on our mobile devices, browser exploitation, data tampering, phishing, etc. In India, more than 740 million people are using smartphones, approximately 54% of India's population, and the number of users is increasing each year which makes them all vulnerable to such attacks. There are many ways to detect malware hidden in our phones, prevent such attacks, and maintain our privacy. In this paper, we will discuss the approaches we can take to ensure all the users are secure and protected, and we will be talking about pegasus spyware, why this is so dangerous, and how we can stay protected from such malware. We will also be discussing an implementation that can be used to detect malware and alert users to take the necessary steps to make the device secure again.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a system to block reverse flow of blood in intravenous line
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In all hospitals and clinics, intravenous (IV) treatment is a standard way of primary treatment. The IV treatment has one disadvantage: the reverse flow of blood flows back into the intravenous tube. Reverse flow is caused by a pressure difference between the intravenous line and the bodily blood flow. To cope with this issue, hospitals regularly monitor the fluid level present in the intravenous line. Even though they check the level constantly, some cases may miss out. So the only way to solve this problem is though blocking the reverse flow. Although several computerized systems have advanced to make the tracking of intravenous infusion easy for both hospitals and clinics, there is no system to block the reverse flow. In this paper, we propose a servomotor-controlled locking gadget to prevent the backflow of blood by using a non-contact liquid level sensor and a microprocessor. It is easy and affordable, making it available even in less market area places.

articleTitle: Tractor drawn turmeric harvester
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Turmeric is a natural herb used as a spice in varieties of food. It originated from India. It can be grown in diverse tropical conditions. The plantation starts during January-March. Harvesting takes place after 9 months of planting. In the manual method of harvesting, the farmers are facing significant problems. Though a mechanized way of harvesting machines is available, it is not affordable for small-scale farmers. To eliminate the difficulties those cultivators face, a tractor-drawn turmeric harvester is designed by reducing the cost of the machine and making it compact to harvest in small farmlands. So that the small-scale farmers can easily afford the machine. The prototype model of the harvesting machine is made with the help of a mild steel frame structure. The damages caused during conventional manual digging methods are reduced with our implemented system. Because of this, the demand for labourers and massive cost consumption is reduced. The better harvesting efficiency by mechanized harvesting would enable the farmer to realize an additional percent of the yield with minor damage to their crops.

articleTitle: A novel forgery detection technique for document images
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Digital documents play an essential role in the day-to-day life of every once life. The documents are shared and exchanged in routine work. At the same time, protecting the document from fraud is a challenging task. The proposed method addresses document forgery detection. In this technique, first, we perform a document enhancement process by removing the noise like salt and pepper and Gaussian using various filtering techniques. Then the enhancement of the contrast by using Histogram Equalization and Contrast stretching. Finally, the deblurring is used to recover the document from degraded observations. In the second process, feature extraction is performed by extracting the color, grey, and entropy features, then the quality measures like Mean Square Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structure Similarity Index Matrix (SSIM) are also used as features. In addition, we use Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for fetching textual information. The proposed method performs both textual and image authentication. The proposed method achieved good performance for document forgery detection compared to previous techniques in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: American sign language hand gesture interpreter
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: For many disabled people who are dumb or deaf sign language is a way of communication, to do communication both people need to know sign language or need a translator between them, but everywhere they are not getting a translator. This project is a prototype that will work as a translator for them so that they can communicate with anyone irrespective of knowledge of sign language. With the help of gestures, we can perform many actions like human-computer interaction, gesture-controlled home appliances, and many applications that use gestures as the trigger input. In this prototype, an image is obtained using a webcam. OpenCV helps in detecting gestures from images. And on a later stage gesture is converted to text. OpenCV is a python package tool that provides support with image processing techniques.

articleTitle: Image analysis using convolutional neural network to detect bird species
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Recognition for bird species is one of the most challenging tasks in visualizing a very abundant bird species. It is a subfield of object recognition and is meant to differentiate sub-categories. Furthermore, it aims to categorize the data, such as images. Therefore, identifying the bird species through images helps us acquire a more accurate result. Thus, we have developed a deep learning model to help users identify bird species. Meanwhile, deep convolutional neural networks have been very effective in dealing with images of having different dimensions and thus succeeding at tasks like object detection and classification, learning various features like edges, colors, etc. Thus, using the neural network model, we have taken 200 different species of birds in the form of images to classify. First, birds images were learned by a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify the dominant features in the images. Then, we used the softmax function to obtain a probability distribution of bird characteristics. Finally, to obtain a more accurate result, we compare our GoogleLeNet model with the VGG16.

articleTitle: Linear motion humidifier for mushroom cultivation
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: India's current mushroom production rate is approximately 1500 tons, while the daily demand for mushrooms is around 75 to 100 tons. Even though new technologies are being developed, the need is not satisfied due to various illnesses afflicting mushroom farms. Fungal diseases such as dry, wet, and cobweb diseases are caused by water stagnation in mushrooms. Maintaining 80-95 percent RH for an extended period in a specific bag limits productivity and harvest quality by reducing cropping surface or damaging mycelium. To address this, pesticides that lower the nutritional value of mushrooms are utilized. Rather than utilizing a water-chemical spraying approach, the problem was solved by using a modified ultrasonic humidifier, which distributes humidity linearly, assuring uniform mist distribution throughout the mushroom sacks and stable RH. Despite the high cost in India, which makes it unaffordable due to the market's high-priced humidifiers, a designed low-cost ultrasonic humidifier is used based on the mechanical principles that emphasize aspects of chemical usage prevention, production rate optimization, and cost-efficiency in the mushroom sector via the deployment of a solution which could have neutralized fungal development and consolidated the fungal infection.

articleTitle: Walker-delta constellation design for LEO-based navigation using small satellites
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: The existing Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) such as GPS (USA), GLONASS (Russia), Galileo (Europe), and COMPASS/Beidou-2 (China) are deployed at an altitude of 20,000 km. The broad applicability of these systems for indoor positioning and Navigation is limited because these navigation signals typical are in L-band and are 20dB below noise level when received at the receiver on the earth, where received signal power is in order - 120 dBm. There is significant growth in utilizing satellite technology through the low earth orbit (LEO) (typically 400 to 1500 km) for various applications, including communication and internet services, which also paved the way to explore the possibility of deploying satellites to meet navigation and positioning services. This is advantageous over MEO-based GNSS, particularly in terms of stronger signals for the system's users on the earth to achieve resilient positioning (both outdoor and indoor). There are many LEO constellation providers to support communication services, including OneWeb, SpaceX, Boeing, and Iridium. However, a total capacity standalone LEO-based navigation constellation is yet to be deployed. In this paper, a small satellite-based LEO constellation for positioning and Navigation is proposed based on the walker-delta pattern.

articleTitle: Enhancing sentiment analysis performance with blend of features and deep learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: In Sentiment analysis, writer's view about products, events, government policies, services, topics, organizations, and individuals is determined through the text written by them on social media platforms like Twitter, and Facebook. Previous researchers focused on getting sentiment either from syntactic and lexical features or by using pre-trained word embeddings. We have combined GloVe pre-trained word embedding,lexicon based features, and Bag of words to form an ensemble feature(FE). We have considered two Twitter datasets namely, US Airlines Twitter, and Stanford Twitter Sentiment Gold (STSGd). We have applied three machine learning algorithms on TF-IDF features, three deep learning algorithms on GloVe word embedding feature. We have proposed a hybrid model which is a combination of LSTM and CNN model with ensemble feature. The proposed model has performed around 2% better on US Airlines Twitter dataset and around 8% better on STS-Gold dataset than state-of-the-art-results. It is observed that ensemble feature improved the performance of algorithms.

articleTitle: Study of MIMO-NOMA-based cognitive integrated satellite-terrestrial relay networks to evaluate system throughput and equity between primary and secondary users
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Integrated satellite and terrestrial networks based on cognitive radio technology have emerged as a valuable platform to address spectrum scarcity, connection (coverage) to white (rural or remote) areas, and spectral efficiency of transmissions. In this system, the terrestrial relays rely on the decode and forward (DF) principle to maintain communication between the end-users and the satellite. These hybrid networks accompanied by terrestrial relays and the NOMA (Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access) techniques, which are based on a new multiplexing domain (powers), are considered a promising solution to improve throughput and fairness between users. Hence, this research framework has recently become the coveted subject of a large population among researchers in radio communications. This paper proposes a review of the performance on the outage criterion of a hybrid system composed of two terrestrial and relay users performing NOMA in the downlink, maximizing the secondary user's transmission (US). This work also describes the mathematical expression of the distribution outage probability of two users of the system and the distribution of the asymptotic probability with a considerable SNR (signal to noise ratio). According to the simulation result, an increase in the number of antennas and gateway (relays) on the terrestrial components can promote good overall system performance.

articleTitle: SR (Supernumerary Robotic) Fingers
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: A wearable robot, namely Supernumerary Robotic Fingers, can be developed to augment the capabilities of the human hand that can help perform a variety of prehensile, bimanual, and manipulation tasks single-handedly. The patients can use the fingers to recover their grasping abilities presenting an active compensatory tool in the initial phases of therapeutic recovery and rehabilitation to promote the use of the arm even if the hand grasp function is not recovered. The patients can intuitively control the two robotic fingers using the flex sensors attached to their fingers through a hand glove and IMU. These robotic fingers may provide chronic hemiparetic patients with assistance to lead independent and productive lives. The proposed solution is intended to act as a rehabilitation device to assist the hands in bimanual tasks like grasping and manipulating objects.

articleTitle: FPGA based area efficient implementation of DDR SDRAM memory controller using verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: SDRAM has more excellent transmission rates than the asynchronous Random-Access Memory (DRAM). To govern the data flow, a memory controller is required. A high-speed memory controller also uses high area/ power consumption in addition to the speed restriction. This requires an optimized memory controller to lower the memory controller's area to work efficiently. This study suggested lowering the memory controller's area by optimizing the controller using bypass registers and optimizing the memory management unit operations. The new generation of remote sensing instruments generates a massive amount of data. The Fast Memory Link Bus, a 64-bit data bus, connects the memory controller and the user module. DDR memory data is sent in a burst manner in both clock edges. The proposed design can be synthesized and verified using simulation results and the performance of the Xilinx 14.4 ISE simulator.

articleTitle: SentNet : a system to recognise human sentiments in real time
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Detecting sentiments through videos would prove to be an important part as nowadays, the conferences, gatherings are being held online due to global pandemic. Teaching has now turned into e-teaching modes. Even doctors are consulting the patients through online video conferencing. So, automated detection of the facial sentiment of the other person becomes the foremost concern. This paper proposes a real-time sentiment analysis end-to-end system using Raspberry Pi to capture videos that are passed into the proposed model after extracting image frames. The model used in the simulator has been trained using the MobileNet model. A distinguished dataset is used which contains features to analyze sentiments of people belonging to multiple ethnicities. The dataset consists of videos, so for training the deep learning model, frames are extracted from the videos. After that, faces are detected from these frames using two methods namely, Haar cascade(OpenCV) and MTCNN. Three different datasets are discussed: PU dataset, FER2013 cleaned dataset and Mixed (PU + FER13 cleaned) dataset. Model is trained using transfer learning on MobileNet Model and finally, hyperparameter tuning for attaining best accuracy. The final best test accuracy obtained is 74.42%, 97.50% and 88.73% in the first, second and third methods respectively.

articleTitle: Pipeline inspection using self-transforming hybrid drive quad-copter
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: This paper discusses a novel design for a convertible hybrid drive quad-copter that is manually controlled to move across inaccessible places as a drone or a 4-wheeler bot using a self-transforming mechanism, equipped with a camera whose feed is accessed and passed through image processing algorithms to inspect various industrial systems like HVAC pipes and check for defects or anomalies such as rust and cracks in the pipes with advanced deep learning algorithms at the controller side. The designed sprawl mechanism enables the bot to reach narrow places and perform inspections. The novel Power Engage Disengage mechanism is crucial in saving power by delivering it either to the wheels (drive mode) or to the propellers (drone mode), but not both at the same time, making sure power is used efficiently which guarantees a longer run time and allows more area to be covered in a single inspection run. A Convolutional Neural Network is designed to detect multiple potential defects that are precise, accurate and yield faster results. With all these features, the designed convertible hybrid drive quad-copter can break dimensional constraints and provide precise analysis of any industrial structure.

articleTitle: Breast cancer detection using optimized hidden convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 7th International Conference on Computing in Engineering & Technology (ICCET 2022)
abstract: Breast cancer is the deadlier ailment, and it is the vital cause for augmented death rates in women. Mammography is the principal method for diagnosing breast cancer.
